section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedures for Study X, including obtaining ethics approval and participant recruitment between May and September 2018. Participants were Malaysian citizens of Malay or Chinese ethnicity, adult age, and fluent in Malay, recruited from community areas like parks and markets. Data was collected using paper-and-pencil questionnaires, and participants were remunerated with gift vouchers.
